Thanks for the quick time on the discovery call yesterday. I sent the Coupa supplier invite earlier this morning (you should see an email from "no-reply@coupa.com" titled "Activate your Summit Labs account"). Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for the ping. We received an email but when I click "Activate account" the browser goes to a Coupa page and returns a 403 with a short message: "Access denied — token invalid". Tried Chrome and Edge, cleared cache, tried incognito. Same result.

I attached a screenshot (screenshot-403-accept.png) and a brief server-side log from our proxy that shows the GET to the accept URL returns 403. We are behind a corporate reverse proxy but other partners have accepted Coupa invites before.

Can you reissue or advise a workaround? PO processing is on a hard timeline so we want to avoid delays.

Thanks —
Raj Patel
Procurement Lead, Summit Labs
raj.patel@summitlabs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>

Subject: Re: Summit Labs — Coupa invite: next steps for supplier onboarding

Hi Raj —

Sorry you're hitting this. We're seeing a small number of invites fail when a RelayState query contains encoded plus signs or when intermediaries strip or rewrite certain headers (Accept-Language / Referer) — that results in the Coupa token validation returning 403 "invalid token".

Karthik, can you take a look at the invite audit (I will attach the invite token log) and advise whether a TTL bump + reissue from the fallback tenant will avoid the problem? Raj, if you can also send the raw invite URL (or forward the invite email) that will help us reproduce.

Workaround we can try immediately: reissue invite with the short-link flow (token in POST body instead of long query param). If that fails we can issue a temporary bulk-accept link and pair you with an onboarding specialist to complete profile manually.

Marissa Cole
Supplier Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: invite-token-audit.txt (text/plain)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@summitlabs.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Summit Labs — Coupa invite: next steps for supplier onboarding

Raj —

Thanks for the attachments, those helped. From the logs the token is valid on our side (issued at 2027-04-04T09:10:14Z) but the request hitting Coupa has a truncated query parameter — the "+" characters in the RelayState appear to be decoded by Summit's proxy and replaced with spaces, which breaks Coupa's HMAC check. Reissuing will help but only if the token arrives intact.

Action taken:
- Reissued invite via the short-link POST flow at 2027-04-06T16:22:00-07:00 (you should get an email with subject "Activate your Summit Labs account — short link")
- Also attached a one-off acceptance endpoint: https://coupa.redwood-internal/accept/short/ab12cd (expires 24 hours) — please open this directly (not via a forwarded proxy) or have IT allowlist coupa.redwood-internal through the proxy for this request.

If the short link still fails, reply with a time window and we'll open a co-browse session and accept on your behalf (we'll still need the W-9 scan afterwards).

Sorry for the friction — we want to get PO routing set up today.

— Karthik Iyer
Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
